description: Unchanged original foreground serve signal and late handoff write-failure cases; all runtime imports independently read.
isolationRationale: Vitest fake EventEmitter child and fake timers; process.emit targets only the isolated test process listeners, not OS signals. Fake kill never signals a real process. One test creates then deletes its own mkdtemp directory and verifies failure writing within that now-missing directory. No real Electron, child spawn, model, service, network or user data access in these cases. Runtime imports include mac bundle polling but no test reaches it; type-only runtime-rpc-envelope is erased. Minimal config is not a general sandbox.
sourceVitestConfigDifferencesFromCapsule: Original installed Vitest4.1.11 with Node24.19.0 on macOS arm64, minimal node config. Original aliases/setupFiles/feature-wall define/GC-webstorage/platform-worker settings are not used by reviewed runtime closure. No full configuration or typecheck equivalence claimed.
Tests simulate Linux/Windows platform property and timers; no native Linux/Windows execution. Original assertions, fake children, and imports unchanged. Default per-case timeout and outer30s.
testEvidenceBoundary: 12 original unit cases only. No installed bundle update, real signal delivery, launchd lifetime, Electron teardown, SSH host, candidate parity or live version-skew proof.
